content:
rachael: quick sync - we have an active/active tenant residency cutover planned EU->NA tomorrow. want a tight operator checklist and abort gates.

matt: agreed. primary risk is fallback storms during lease-swap. propose: kv-snapshot -> prewarm -> canary -> lease-swap with safety TTL -> promote.

jyoti: add consent and residency-allow checks up front. if a tenant is not allowed in NA, exclude from batch. also require consent_stamp_age < 24h.

sam: ops checklist (short):
- legal consent validated by natalie
- kv snapshot uploaded to region bucket
- standby pools prewarmed with weights and KV
- canary 1% for 10m; abort if p95>220ms or errors>0.5%

rachael: runbook snippet to paste:
```
./scripts/kv_capture --tenants=tenants.csv --out=s3://eu-archives/$CUTOVER_ID
./scripts/consent_check --file tenants.csv || abort
POST /v1/pools/standby?action=prewarm&cutover=$ID
route 1% -> NA for 10m; monitor thresholds
POST /v1/leases/swap?tenants=@tenants.csv&timeout=180s
POST /v1/pools/promote?cutover=$ID
post-validate checksums sample=100 mismatch>1% => rollback
```

matt: clarify "timeout=180s" - we rely on controller aggregate for lease count. add fallback: if leases != 0 after TTL, auto-abort and revert routing.

jyoti: also check per-proxy heartbeat for high-traffic tenants. inflight-requests heuristic: if >500 after prewarm, hold canary.

natalie: I'll provide consent.csv by 11:30Z. will flag GDPR-excluded tenants.

sam: telemetry: add `cutover_id` to metrics/traces and `X-Cutover-ID` header to requests. dashboards with that tag.

oliver: include dry-run mode in scripts so we can validate orchestration without flipping routing. `--dry-run` should run all checks and simulate leases.

rachael: action items: runbook + preflight script (rachael), script review @0930 (matt), checksum/semantic probes (jyoti), consent list (natalie), dashboard tagging (sam). infra-bot: schedule canary window tomorrow 14:00Z.

infra-bot: deploybot: Cutover plan created: cutover-2765432100 by rachael. Canary: 2026-03-26T14:00Z.

matt: add explicit rollback commands in runbook (revert leases, drain standby, restore routing header).

rachael: will include exact rollback commands and a short decision matrix. will push draft before EOD. :white_check_mark:
